recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future cleanup of the unreferenced legacy Composition valueset-doc-categorycodes.xml file or broader category terminology questions should be handled as separate work, not as a FHIR-8057 source fix.
issue_request: FHIR-8057 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It requested removing Composition.class and DocumentReference.class from core as MHD/XDS-only metadata; the final decision rejected removal, found class/category not redundant with type, and requested clearer documentation plus an example value set based on the LOINC Document Kind hierarchy.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites svn revision 5993, represented in git by 995666d69f5f472f2f493a231edee9c2be1c967e. That commit kept class in core, changed Composition.class binding metadata from DocumentC80Class to DocumentClass, and added source/composition/valueset-doc-classcodes.xml with LOINC Document Kind LP codes. The related documentation clarification was handled by FHIR-5561 in commit a4f7d63ab329bf6443e65c4ec50d5d88c53c029e.
additional_context: Later final issues changed the current source surface without reversing FHIR-8057. FHIR-11907 replaced the old LOINC Part-code class value set approach, FHIR-17171 and FHIR-17555 renamed DocumentReference.class and Composition.class to category, and FHIR-32577 renamed document-classcodes to referenced-item-category because DocumentReference can reference more than documents.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current build-scope source has active Composition and DocumentReference resources, maps the old class names to category in fhir.ini, and binds both current category elements to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/referenced-item-category. No source edit is needed for FHIR-8057.
